page.layout: One title page, all lines centred. Upper block: a small line, a large title, a subtitle, and a block of small italic lines. Below: a small engraved vignette, then the printer's imprint at the foot.
page.notes: The title page is very faint and the scan is low in contrast, so most of the small lines cannot be read letter by letter and are marked illegible. The top line and the large title are readable. The subtitle and the lines below it are mostly illegible, and only rough word shapes can be seen. The engraving below the text is a figure or vignette with no printed text, so it is not transcribed. The imprint at the foot is a faint two-line printer's note, also illegible. Show-through from the reverse is present and is not transcribed. Only the printed lines that can be seen are given. No page number or running head is printed.
